records.title: Build project digital twins
records.finding: The actual simulate() function computes an explicitly illustrative queueing scenario; the route persists scenario results and the twin screen displays them. This is real implemented functionality, but no staging replica or calibration dataset was found.

criteria.requirement: Predictions are calibrated against real staging outcomes and documented uncertainty.
criteria.observed: No measured staging outcomes, model calibration or uncertainty dataset is implemented. Existing tests establish arithmetic only.

criteria.requirement: Twin changes cannot affect production or expose sensitive data.
criteria.observed: The route stores modeled results and does not deploy a scenario; no production-connected twin or sanitized staging-data boundary exists to qualify.

records.nextAction: Implement a versioned, isolated staging replica and compare repeated measured outcomes against the model before claiming a calibrated twin.

records.title: Add cost and revenue impact models
records.finding: simulate() multiplies user-entered per-replica cost by replicas and labels the result modeled. This is a hypothetical cost calculation, not an authorized billing or revenue integration.

criteria.requirement: Scenarios trace to real input data and explicitly distinguish forecasts from facts.
criteria.observed: Modeled cost and assumptions are visibly distinguished from measured production predictions. Inputs are manually entered and lack billing provenance.

criteria.requirement: Revenue and cost access is permission-controlled.
criteria.observed: The private Sites gateway is the existing workspace boundary; revenue-specific grants, retention and real-data access checks are absent.

records.nextAction: Add authorized billing/revenue provenance and permission-scoped observations, then calibrate cost/revenue scenarios against actual outcomes.

records.title: Replace future-state templates with evaluated plans
records.finding: The future action persists V2/V3/V5/V10 horizons with project ID, title and gap count. The horizon text remains a common template; its method string explicitly states no market research or predictions were performed.

criteria.requirement: Every horizon has project-specific evidence and testable milestones.
criteria.observed: Project association and gap count exist, but each horizon lacks its own project-specific evidence, measurable milestone and immutable evaluation result.

criteria.requirement: Predictions remain hypotheses with evaluations, not guaranteed futures.
criteria.observed: Existing UI labels horizons Proposed and Validation required, and route method declares templates; actual forecast evaluation is not implemented.

records.nextAction: Create immutable horizon evidence and testable milestone contracts; preserve source cutoffs and unresolved forecasts instead of treating them as successful.

records.title: Connect product and business intelligence
records.finding: Generic memory, decision records and lexical source search are implemented. Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics and Revenue Optimization are specialist/catalog names. No typed customer/financial observations, objective-linked recommendation engine or scoped business ingestion path was found.

criteria.requirement: Recommendations reference real evidence and measurable business objectives.
criteria.observed: Generic record citations are available, but no business recommendation is tied to real product/customer evidence and measurable business objectives.

criteria.requirement: Sensitive business/customer data has scoped access and retention.
criteria.observed: The owner-private workspace is not a business-data retention or per-source access implementation; no business-specific retention policy is executed.

records.nextAction: Add minimal typed objective/observation records and authorized sources, including explicit retention and evidence-linked recommendations.

records.title: Build innovation discovery and validation
records.finding: An Innovation Discovery specialist and a UI note directing users to save research exist. The note explicitly avoids assuming novelty, revenue or patent eligibility. No enforced proposal/competitor/experiment-result lifecycle exists.

criteria.requirement: Proposals include sources, competing solutions, validation plans and experimental results.
criteria.observed: Generic Research memory can hold text but does not require sources, competing solutions, validation plans or measured experiment results.

criteria.requirement: The system does not claim that nobody has built something without evidence.
criteria.observed: The UI explicitly says novelty, revenue and patent eligibility are not assumed. This wording is not a complete constraint on model-generated innovation claims.

records.nextAction: Build a small evidence-gated opportunity lifecycle with alternatives, experiment metrics, stop criteria and retained failed outcomes.

records.title: Complete executive intelligence scores
records.finding: Added all original fourteen named executive dimensions, documented methodology, required evidence, next actions, source/revision references, confidence/coverage and explicit null/unassessed measurements. Existing seven snapshot indicators are labeled separately. No aggregate score or certification is inferred from heuristic cleanliness.

sourceCandidates.sourceBinding: Working-tree SHA-256; publishing commit is to be recorded by root after commit.
Working-tree SHA-256; publishing commit is to be recorded by root after commit.
Working-tree SHA-256; root publishing commit provides immutable source.

criteria.requirement: All 14 dimensions have documented methodology and evidence or an explicit unassessed state.
criteria.observed: Eleven executed model and actual React static-render tests show all fourteen dimensions have methodology, required evidence and explicit unassessed states; native detail controls render their evidence and next actions. Actual React markup includes all fourteen disclosures. Browser interaction is separately blocked by scratch-host reachability.

criteria.requirement: A score never implies a certification or unsupported measurement.
criteria.observed: Tests show perfect heuristic input scores, absent evidence, malformed records and accessibility-only signals cannot create measured executive scores or certification. Actual React markup preserves these labels and safely escapes user-controlled project text. Browser/assistive interaction remains unverified.

records.nextAction: Retain unassessed status until qualified measured data exists. Root may record the two local presentation clauses with their exact test evidence; full browser interaction and executive trend/measurement capabilities remain separate requirements.

records.title: Complete accessibility and responsive verification
records.finding: Responsive styles, native controls and keyboard handlers for SVG graph nodes exist. Two genuine gaps were found: the entity and finding tables used clickable rows with no keyboard action. Replaced both with native labeled buttons while retaining table semantics. Executive evidence uses native details/summary.

criteria.requirement: Representative viewport and assistive-technology journeys pass with recorded findings.
criteria.observed: Root will run the repaired journeys at desktop/mobile; a full independent assistive-technology and all critical journeys audit is not yet reproduced.

criteria.requirement: All critical actions work without a mouse.
criteria.observed: Entity and finding inspection now use keyboard-operable buttons. Remaining critical actions require the complete journey audit, not just static source inspection.

records.nextAction: Keyboard-test graph/finding inspection and focus return; then complete connect, inspect, review, cancel/reconcile, budget and assistive-technology journeys.

records.title: Implement scoped compliance and legal auditing
records.finding: Compliance and Legal Auditing are source-review specialists. jobs.ts explicitly records an unqualified-tool capability gap for Legal Auditing, and the analyzer scope excludes legal certification. No jurisdiction/control evidence collector or legal interpretation workflow was found.

criteria.requirement: Reports distinguish measured controls, missing evidence and legal interpretation.
criteria.observed: Generic model review and capability-gap output do not implement control measurement, missing-evidence collection and jurisdiction-aware legal interpretation.

criteria.requirement: No unsupported certification or legal conclusion is issued.
criteria.observed: Analyzer and job scopes avoid claiming legal certification; complete legal report output and qualified-review checks are still missing.

records.nextAction: Implement scoped control/evidence reports from selected standards and jurisdictions, clearly separating measurement from qualified interpretation.

records.title: Prepare release documentation and operating evidence
records.finding: There are actual worker setup/doctor instructions, companion account/model/recovery guidance, signed updater code and capability/evidence limits. These should not be treated as absent. No complete independent fresh-operator setup/recover/upgrade reproduction for all shipped platform capabilities is recorded.

criteria.requirement: A new authorized operator can set up, verify, recover and upgrade the platform using the docs.
criteria.observed: Worker/companion setup and recovery instructions exist; the entire operator flow still needs a clean authorized host plus live gateway/provider configuration and real Docker.

criteria.requirement: Release notes accurately distinguish engineering work, activation and verification.
criteria.observed: Status docs distinguish local stubs, absent Docker and account consent; some historical states are stale and newest HANDOFF sections remain authoritative.

records.nextAction: Consolidate a single release runbook and execute clean setup, verification, recovery and upgrade on the intended supported host.
